targetAliasDefect.reproduction: Place a collapsed caret after the P child in the first bullet item, then send browser keyboard input. Chromium/WebKit retain Selection(P,1), report beforeinput StaticRange(#text,18), and previously cancel all input without committing.
targetAliasDefect.rootCause: Ordinary target validation compared exact endpoint kind/path/affinity rather than the spatial positions already required by the event contract
targetAliasDefect.fix: Compare validated spatial endpoints within the same actual text-block path. Preserve captured endpoint forms, direction and affinities in the command. Keep different block paths distinct and retain the existing narrowly bounded trailing-space alias.
